title: Community feed and events
description: Community posts, comments, reactions, scheduled events, and current focus. Moderators run events; members talk in the feed.
content:
A community is more than a list. Members post in the feed. Moderators can schedule events and set current focus reading.

Primary action: Open Communities

Feed

  • Members publish posts, optionally linked to a hub, file, or list item.
  • Comments and replies sit on the post.
  • Reactions: like, love, insightful.

Events

  • Moderators schedule, update, or cancel events.
  • Join links can point at Zoom, Meet, or another URL you paste.
  • Reminder emails can go out before the start time.

Focus

Moderators set (or clear) current reading material: a hub or a file. That is the community’s “what we are on now,” not a paywall.
